build_model_vfnet_r50: build a VFNet object detection model with ResNet-50 backbone and FPN neck for COCO detection
create_data_pipeline_train: create a training data pipeline that loads images, resizes with keep ratio, applies random flip, and packs detection inputs
configure_loss_functions: configure VarifocalLoss for classification and GIoULoss for bounding box regression in VFNet head
setup_training_schedule: setup a 12-epoch training schedule with LinearLR warmup and MultiStepLR decay at epochs 8 and 11
configure_inference_settings: configure test-time inference with NMS pre-filtering, score threshold 0.05, IoU threshold 0.6, and max 100 detections per image
